name: Dathan
title: The Rebel Against Moses
summary: Dathan was a Reubenite who, together with his brother Abiram and the Levite Korah, led a rebellion against the leadership of Moses and Aaron in the wilderness. He and the other rebels were swallowed by the earth as God's judgment on their disobedience and revolt.

keyEvents.title: The Rebellion Against Moses and Aaron
keyEvents.description: Dathan joined forces with Korah, Abiram, and 250 leaders to challenge the authority of Moses and Aaron, claiming that the entire community was holy.

keyEvents.title: Refused to Meet Moses
keyEvents.description: When Moses called for Dathan and Abiram, they refused to come and accused Moses of leading them out of a land flowing with milk and honey.

keyEvents.title: Dathan at his tent
keyEvents.description: Dathan and Abiram stood at the entrance of their tents with their wives and children when judgment came.

keyEvents.title: The earth swallowed the rebels
keyEvents.description: As God's judgment, the earth opened up and swallowed Dathan, Abiram, and their families along with everything they owned.

keyEvents.title: A warning sign
keyEvents.description: Dathan's fate was remembered in Israel as a warning example against rebellion against God's chosen leaders.
